name: @aspect-mark/agent-pipeline
description: MCP server providing pipeline orchestration tools — manage multi-agent workflows with status tracking, role prompts, and a web dashboard

tools.name: pipeline_status
tools.description: Get current pipeline status with phase progress

tools.name: pipeline_update_phase
tools.description: Update the status of a pipeline phase or subtask

tools.name: pipeline_init_project
tools.description: Initialize multi-agent workflow in a project

tools.name: pipeline_dashboard
tools.description: Start or stop the web monitoring dashboard

tools.name: pipeline_role_prompt
tools.description: Get system prompt content for a specific role

tools.name: pipeline_finalize
tools.description: Mark pipeline as done or failed
